# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 10 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 10:3 — bright and shining at birth — Cain's appearance

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "bright and shining at his birth" | Literal clarus et lucidus |
| LOGOS | "bright and shining at his birth" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "bright and radiant at birth" | Synonym substitution |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET and LOGOS agree. The description of Cain as 'bright and shining' ironically mirrors the angelic appearance and is theologically significant. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
